title: not connecting
body: I started using the miao miao with the freestyle libre and xdrip+ and it was working fine. I tried changing the algorithm to the oopalgorithm, but it didn't work and I lost the connection between the miao miao and xdrip+. I tried deleting the app and downloading it a few times, but it doesn't seem to connect and is stock on the collecting initial data screen. Does anyone know how I can make them connect again? do I have to wait until I put in a new sensor?

comments.body:
No need to wait for a new sensor.
Very likely you should go to settings->less common settings->other misc options
and disable "out of process libre algorithm"

Hey. I tried that but it didn't help. I also deleted the app and reinstalled it so that would put the settings back to default. The app does see the miao miao, but it's not actually getting any data. Do you have any ideas of what to do?

Does it show connected on status screen?

It's a bit weird because I also had these apps the first time I connected, and it didn't seem to cause a problem so i'm not sure. thank you for your help!
